record.title: Prepare one stopped diagnostic with a reversible host network fixture
record.intent: Coexist with the operator's VM networking while preserving isolated bench acquisition.
requirements: Operator identified Docker as the host-network state change and explicitly directed coexistence and continued experiments. Preserve original diagnostic and stopped182200 evidence; no retry of a completed root. Prepare one fresh concrete root and independent source review before execution.

Preserve enabled packet filtering, complete specific translation/rule anchor configuration, bootpd interface-specific configuration and unrelated VM services/processes. Capture exact initial IPv4/IPv6 forwarding and temporarily set only those values to zero before any scope address or contact. Disclose that unrelated VM forwarded traffic can pause. Never disable, flush or rewrite firewall/security policy, sharing, DHCP configuration, unrelated processes or external routes.

Require read-only runtime proof of scope-interface identity, no bridge, correct local route after owned alias, no gateway/DNS, DHCP service excluded from scope interface and no applicable scope NAT/redirect path. Check forwarding zero and preserved relevant policy/configuration at serviced boundaries. Unexpected changes stop acquisition without repeated forced writes or an unchanged retry.

Retain exactly one nominal100MHz/raw0 UART attempt and one fresh RUN-to-STOP RAW100k/count1/4G/100mVdiv record, declared strict abs0.36V/Vpp0.72V headroom and unchanged default receive interpretation. No comparison slot, native transition, reboot, root restart, protected material or wiring change.

Preserve full ordinary/export restoration and three stock epoch checks. Close scoped transport, retire/reap owned ADB and prove full endpoint absence, remove/prove owned alias absent and stop owned DHCP/capture with drop statistics before restoring exact initial forwarding. Uncertain cleanup must HOLD isolation and never re-enable forwarding into an uncertain scope path. Independently review focused fixture positive/failure/restore controls and exact unchanged physical/numerical callbacks, pins and runtime import behavior.
acceptance: One independently reviewed concrete diagnostic and host fixture is accepted or held without physical execution during preparation.
